title: Mini PC Held In Hand
description: A scale poster: a small desktop computer held in one hand against a workshop wall with a port callout.
prompt:
Create a scale poster for a very small desktop computer, vertical 4:5.

Brand: "{{brand_name}}"

Scene: a hand holds the mini computer up towards the camera, fingers wrapped around the {{device_finish}} case so the size against the palm is unmistakable. Skin looks like skin, with a short nail and a faint ink mark on one knuckle. Behind the hand, softly out of focus, a workshop wall with a pegboard, a coiled network cable and the edge of a monitor. Daylight from a high window on the right and a fluorescent tube overhead give two slightly different colours of light, and the case shows a fingerprint near the top corner. Grain in the background, corners a touch soft.

Text layout: the brand name top left in small capitals. "{{headline_text}}" runs down the left side in three short lines of heavy type, clear of the hand. Two thin {{accent_color}} leader lines point at the case and read "{{callout_list}}". A single line across the bottom carries "{{spec_chips}}", and under it in smaller type "{{footnote_text}}".

Invented brand only, no real manufacturers, no real logos, no existing model names. Handheld documentary photography, mixed daylight and tube light, honest skin tone, no retouching.
